entities.summary: The Dunedin sound was a musical and cultural movement in Dunedin, Otago, New Zealand, in the early 1980s. It helped found indie rock as a genre. The scene is associated with Flying Nun Records, an independent label. Dunedin sound is a music genre, created circa 1981. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
